svg.title: An approval step, its notice and escalation
svg.desc: A module sends a document into a chain. Platform works out the steps from the conditions, then opens a work item and writes the notice to the outbox in one transaction. A daily job reminds and escalates. A decision closes the work item and opens the next step.
